h: Lere Olayinka reportedly asks DSS and police to probe viral video said to threaten Christians in Jos and Enugu
p: The media aide to the FCT Minister has reportedly alerted security agencies to a video that allegedly calls for violence against Christians. He wants the clip investigated and those behind it identified. The origin and authenticity of the video have not been independently verified.
more: Security agencies had not publicly responded at the time of the report.
The call comes amid heightened political tension ahead of the 2027 elections.
